Body.Content:
What and Why:

Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) is retiring two classic alerts at the end of November 2026: Remote code execution attempt (RCE) and Suspected identity theft (pass-the-hash). This update aligns detection workflows with current Microsoft Defender XDR and endpoint monitoring capabilities.

Rollout Schedule:

General Availability (Worldwide, GCC, GCC High, DoD): We will begin rolling out in late November 2026 and expect to complete by late November 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

- Security teams using classic MDI alert workflows for RCE and pass-the-hash scenarios.

Platforms/Services:

- Microsoft Defender for Identity

- Microsoft Defender XDR services

What will happen:

- The two classic alerts will no longer be available after rollout completes.

- RCE activity can continue to be monitored with a custom detection rule in Advanced Hunting.

- Pass-the-hash monitoring should continue through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint on onboarded devices.

Action Required/Recommendations:

Before the end of November 2026:

- Create an Advanced Hunting custom detection rule for RCE scenarios using the published query.

- Confirm pass-the-hash detection coverage through Defender for Endpoint on onboarded devices.

- Review guidance: MDI classic alerts documentation.

- Use the published query: RCE custom detection query.

Compliance considerations:

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

Title: Retired: Microsoft Defender for Identity classic alerts (Remote code execution attempt and pass-the-hash)
